data.one_liner: Generates random light and dark Material Design color schemes respecting WCAG guidelines.
data.what_it_does: Generates random light and dark Material Design color schemes based on HSLuv and WCAG accessibility standards. It prints the generated theme in the terminal so developers can copy the code for their apps.
use_when: You want to quickly prototype or explore different color combinations for a Material app
You need automatically generated themes that guarantee WCAG contrast compliance
avoid_when: You require a strict, predefined corporate brand color palette
You need complete manual control over every exact color shade in production
strengths: Guarantees minimum accessibility thresholds using HSLuv
Prints generated color values to the terminal for easy copying
Supports seeding for reproducible random color schemes
weaknesses: Color generation is random, which may not fit specific design requirements
Limited to random variations rather than exact palette curation

alternatives.name: flex_seed_scheme
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you want advanced seed-based color generation for Material 3 rather than random generation.
